guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) As rivers are dying, ecosystem are facing catastrophic consequences, impacting biodiversity. (b) Many rivers in our counry have lost their lives because of unchecked pollution. (c) If the condition is going on, our ecosystem will lose its balance. (d) Many fish species are also dying out as an adverse effect of climate change. (e) It is high time, we take proper steps regarding this issue.
